formats.title: Client return body
formats.producedBy: Hand-built from the IRS scenario PDF
formats.description: What one client company files: its Filer block (EIN, name, name control, address), the calendar-year tax period, and ReturnData with Form 940 and any schedule. It carries no Pyramos values. ClientReturnBody.load parses it, locks returnVersion to 2026v2.0, reads the taxYr attribute, and checks that ReturnData opens with IRS940. The 2026v2.0 schema package is not in the repo yet, so every IRS940, IRS940ScheduleA and IRS940ScheduleR element name is unverified; line-mapping.tsv marks each one.

formats.title: Line mapping
formats.description: One row per value in the client body: which form line it comes from, the XML element path, the value, the PDF page, a confidence, and the name source. confidence is known when the name is taken verbatim from a bundled 2026Q1v4.0 schema where it means the same thing (ReturnHeader94x for Filer, IRS941 or IRS941ScheduleR for the same line on the sibling form), and guess when it is made up from the 940 line text. Two independent transcriptions were reconciled against the PDF; every value agreed, and the element names follow the 941 family's patterns.

formats.title: Composed Return
formats.description: The full Return IRS receives. The composer wraps the client body in a ReturnHeader with OriginatorTypeCd ReportingAgent, a ReportingAgentPINGrp, and a ReportingAgent94XFilerGrp naming Pyramos. This snapshot uses stand-in originator values (EFIN 000000, PIN 00000, agent EIN 000000000) and a fixed clock of 2026-10-13T14:00Z. A live send fills those from MEF_EFIN, MEF_RA_PIN, MEF_SOFTWARE_ID and the other MEF_RA_* settings. The 940 snapshot is not schema-checked until the 2026v2.0 bundle lands.

formats.title: Manifest
formats.description: The IRS submission manifest that travels next to the Return in the submission archive: SubmissionId, EFIN, TaxYr, GovernmentCd, FederalSubmissionTypeCd, the calendar-year tax period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31), and the client TIN. The snapshot uses the fixed submission id 0000002026286abc1234. A live send mints EFIN + yyyyDDD + 7 random characters.

scenarios.title: Zinnia Company, single-state Form 940 with a refund

status.note: Composed offline (AtsScenarioComposeTest). Schema validation waits for the 2026v2.0 bundle.

scenarios.summary: A single-state (Arizona) Form 940 for 2026. $4,000 of payments above the $7,000 wage base come off $200,000 of payments, leaving $196,000 of taxable FUTA wages and $1,176 of tax. Deposits of $2,886 produce a $1,710 overpayment, refunded.
tests: Line 1a single state (AZ), no Schedule A
Line 5 payments in excess of $7,000 flow through line 6 to line 7
Line 8 at the 0.006 net FUTA rate
Line 15a overpayment with 'Send a refund' on line 15b, no direct deposit
notes: The city prints as 'TuFVRQ' in the PDF text layer (broken font map); the rendered page reads Tucson. ZIP 85641 is copied as printed.

Element-name rulings: line 1a SingleStateCd (other candidates OneStateCd, StateAbbreviationCd), line 5 PaymentsExceedingWageBaseAmt (TotalExcessPaymentsAmt), line 13 TotalTaxDepositAmt from IRS941 (FUTATaxDepositedAmt), line 15 OverpaymentGrp/OverpaidAmt/RefundOverpaymentInd from IRS941 (OverpaymentAmt/RefundInd), lines 16a-d TaxLiabilityQtr1Amt..Qtr4Amt after IRS941 TaxLiabilityMonth1Amt (FirstQuarter...Amt), line 17 TotalTaxLiabilityAmt (TotalYearLiabilityAmt).
No balance due and no requested payment date, so no payment record.
Responsible Party Current Indicator: Yes (PDF p.1). The composer's constant IRSResponsiblePrtyInfoCurrInd=true matches.
Signature Option: 'Use the signature method applicable to you' (PDF p.1). Part 7 is blank; Pyramos signs with ReportingAgentPINGrp.

Part 6 third-party designee: neither Yes nor No is checked and no designee is named (form page 2). The composer's DiscussWithThirdPartyNoInd=X is the only consistent header choice, since no designee exists to report.
Amounts are written with cents (200000.00), as the PDF prints them and as the 941 schema types them (USDecimalAmountNNType). One transcription wrote whole dollars; overruled.

scenarios.title: Poppy Company, multi-state Form 940 with Schedule A credit reduction

status.note: Composed offline (AtsScenarioComposeTest). Schema validation waits for the 2026v2.0 bundle.

scenarios.summary: A multi-state employer (NY and VI) that paid wages in a credit-reduction state. $100,000 of retirement/pension payments are exempt, leaving $250,000 of taxable FUTA wages. Schedule A applies the Virgin Islands 0.045 credit reduction ($11,250), which raises the tax to $12,750. The $250 overpayment is applied to the next return.
tests: Line 1b multi-state and line 2 credit-reduction checkboxes, both pointing to Schedule A
Line 4 exempt payments with only 4c (retirement/pension) checked
Schedule A: NY checked with no amounts, VI with wages x 0.045 = 11250.00
Line 11 equals the Schedule A total; line 12 = 1500.00 + 11250.00
notes: Schedule A is modelled as one repeating StateGrp per checked state (NY bare, VI with wages, rate and reduction), as one transcription did. The other split NY into a bare code and VI into a CreditReductionGrp; one row shape per state follows the form.
Line 6 is SubtotalAmt in every scenario. The transcriptions used SubtotalAmt in scenario 1 but TotalExemptWagesAmt or TotalExemptPaymentsAmt here; line 6 is line 4 + line 5, not only exempt payments.
Line 4 is a flat ExemptPaymentsAmt followed by RetirementPensionInd, in form order. One transcription wrapped both in ExemptPaymentsGrp; there is no schema evidence for the wrapper.

Line 1b MultiStateInd (other candidate MultiStateEmployerInd); line 7 TotalTaxableFUTAWagesAmt (TotalTaxableWagesAmt); line 12 TotalFUTATaxAfterAdjustmentsAmt (FUTATaxAfterAdjustmentsAmt); line 15b ApplyOverpaymentNextReturnInd from IRS941 (ApplyToNextReturnInd).
No balance due and no requested payment date, so no payment record.
Responsible Party Current Indicator: Yes (PDF p.1). The composer's constant IRSResponsiblePrtyInfoCurrInd=true matches.
Signature Option: 'Use the signature method applicable to you' (PDF p.1). Part 7 is blank; Pyramos signs with ReportingAgentPINGrp.

Part 6 third-party designee: neither Yes nor No is checked and no designee is named (form page 2). The composer's DiscussWithThirdPartyNoInd=X is the only consistent header choice, since no designee exists to report.
Amounts are written with cents (200000.00), as the PDF prints them and as the 941 schema types them (USDecimalAmountNNType). One transcription wrote whole dollars; overruled.

scenarios.title: Crocus Company Inc, Section 3504 agent aggregate Form 940 with Schedule R and a balance due

status.note: Composed offline; schema validation waits for the 2026v2.0 bundle. The PDF asks for the $360.00 balance due to be paid with the return (requested payment date within 5 days of submission), and the composer emits no IRSPayment. Precedent: ATS accepted the Orchid 941-X (balance due, no IRSPayment) on 2026-10-14, so an unpaid send is likely accepted. Ask e-Help, or add IRSPayment before sending.

scenarios.summary: A Section 3504 agent files an aggregate Form 940 for three clients and its own employees, all in Texas. Each of the four allocations is $140,000 of taxable FUTA wages, $840 of tax and $750 of deposits. Deposits of $3,000 against $3,360 of tax leave a $360 balance due.
tests: Aggregate filer box 'Section 3504 agent' on both Form 940 and Schedule R
Schedule R client rows 1-3, subtotal line 16, own employees line 18, totals line 19
Schedule R line 19 ties to Form 940 lines 7, 12 and 13
Line 14 balance due of $360.00 (under $500, payable with the return)

keyFigures.label: Schedule R total taxable FUTA wages

notes: Requested Payment Date: 'Must be within 5 days of the return submission date' (PDF p.1). The PDF gives no bank routing or account number. Paying the $360.00 with the return needs an IRSPayment document (routing, account, type, RequestedPaymentDt, payment amount) in ReturnData; the composer emits none. Sent as is, the return files with an unpaid balance.

Schedule R follows the 941 Schedule R structure verbatim: Section3504AgentInd, repeating ClientInformationGrp (EIN, then the 940-only state column, then ClientAllocationInformationGrp), SubtotalForClientGrp, AggregateEmployeeInfoGrp, TotalAggregateAndClientInfoGrp. One transcription used that structure; the other invented ClientAllocationGrp, ClientSubtotalGrp, EmployerOwnAmountsGrp and TotalsGrp.

Schedule R column amounts reuse the Form 940 line names (TotalTaxableFUTAWagesAmt, TotalFUTATaxAfterAdjustmentsAmt, TotalTaxDepositAmt), as 941 Schedule R reuses the IRS941 names. Columns c, e and f and line 17 are blank and omitted.

Schedule R column (h) is headed 'deposits plus any payment made with the return', yet line 19 is 3000.00, equal to line 13. The $360.00 balance is not allocated on Schedule R. The fixture keeps the printed values.
Schedule R line 18 column (h) prints '750 00' without the decimal mark; 2250.00 + 750.00 = 3000.00 confirms 750.00.
Client EIN 003000004 on Schedule R line 3 is also scenario 1's (941) Orchid EIN. It is IRS test data and is copied as printed.
Line 1a SingleStateCd; one transcription used a bare StateAbbreviationCd here, the other SingleStateCd. Lines 16a-d TaxLiabilityQtr1Amt..Qtr4Amt flat, with no wrapper group.
Responsible Party Current Indicator: Yes (PDF p.1). The composer's constant IRSResponsiblePrtyInfoCurrInd=true matches.
Signature Option: 'Use the signature method applicable to you' (PDF p.1). Part 7 is blank; Pyramos signs with ReportingAgentPINGrp.

Part 6 third-party designee: neither Yes nor No is checked and no designee is named (form page 2). The composer's DiscussWithThirdPartyNoInd=X is the only consistent header choice, since no designee exists to report.
Amounts are written with cents (200000.00), as the PDF prints them and as the 941 schema types them (USDecimalAmountNNType). One transcription wrote whole dollars; overruled.
